items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I think I got a lot of credit from what he taught me... He really put me on the ball when it comes down to that.

ctx.x: Well Baby Dodds said that he had a famous press roll, that Baby copied his press roll from Tubby.

Yeah, a good right foot. Good foot too. Yeah, yeah, that guy, his pedal was bent, I don't know whether the weight he put on it or what. That guy could play a show with his foot. I imagine that was that fast, see. But he was just a little different from us. See, Ori, that's one thing about I give Ori credit for him, he always liked good rhythm. He didn't want all that fancy stuff in there, but he wanted good rhythm. And that's why I think I got a lot of credit from what he taught me, you know. I give him that…
What kind of a drum set did you have when you started out? Your very first drum set? Or what you played on Tubby's set I guess when you started.
